changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names by removing version details and consolidating duplicates. All extracted metadata was accurate and relevant.
Normalized capitalization for consistency. Removed duplicate entries. These are the primary automatic evaluation metrics used in the paper.
The paper does not use LLMs as judges/evaluators. LLMs are used for generation/planning, but not for post-generation assessment.
The paper does not conduct human evaluations. All evaluations are automated using success/completion rates based on ground truth from EHR queries.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on EHR question answering through code generation and execution. The main NLG aspect is generating code plans (Python/SQL) to answer natural language questions about medical records. Evaluation is automated using success/completion rates based on query execution results. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge methods are used.
